on Wednesday it received a NYSE noncompliance notice for failing to meet market capitalization requirements.
The company had an average global market capitalization below $50M over 30 consecutive trading days while stockholders' equity was also below $50M.
Sequans has 90 days to present a compliance plan outlining actions to regain compliance within the nine-month cure period.
The NYSE will assess the plan and determine within 45 days of receipt whether the company has demonstrated an ability to regain compliance.
The company said its compliance plan will include actions such as its Bitcoin treasury exit, strengthened financial position, and focus on its semiconductor growth strategy.

title: Sequans receives NYSE noncompliance notice
